about: The world in areas, and the standard each is raised to (docs/world-areas.md). Every region belongs to one area. Tick a package by adding its id to the area's "done" with the date. Check with `dotnet run --project tools/world -- areas`.

stages.name: Geography
stages.goal: The land is right: its shape, water and ground read as the brief says, walked at player height.

packages.name: Brief
packages.done: docs/areas/<id>.md written from the template (docs/world-areas.md) and agreed: what it is for, who lives there, palette, landmarks and views, routes in and out, resources and creatures by count, its sites.

packages.name: Taken over
packages.done: Its generated regions are frozen into their own data ("generated" removed) and their scenes moved to Assets/Scenes/<Area>/; tools/world check clean.

packages.name: Landforms
packages.done: Terrain shaped to the brief (hills, valleys, cliffs where meant, nowhere else); no seams at its borders; no unreachable pockets.

packages.name: Water
packages.done: Every river rises and ends somewhere visible, lakes sit level, shores and banks read right, falls where the river steps, a crossing wherever a route meets water.

packages.name: Ground
packages.done: Four or five underlays and one or two overlays at most; no stains or speckle; contrasting ground crisp; checked in the Editor.

packages.name: Walked
packages.done: The owner has walked it at player height with both camera profiles, entering and leaving by every route, and signed it off.

stages.name: Structure
stages.goal: The layout is right: roads, settlements, landmarks and edges are where they will stay.

packages.name: Routes
packages.done: Roads and paths final (classes, widths, junctions, bridges); every route meets its neighbour area's at the border.

packages.name: Settlements
packages.done: Every settlement blocked out: buildings as blocks with roofs, squares, walls; every building earns its place; the three-tile gap rule holds.

packages.name: Landmarks
packages.done: Its one or two landmarks placed and seen from where the brief says; views kept clear.

packages.name: Edges
packages.done: Every edge of what can be walked reads as an edge (cliff, water, fence, thicket); no invisible walls.

packages.name: Sites
packages.done: Each site in the area has its footprint (a cave mouth, a ruin's outline, an arena) so content can be built into it.

packages.name: Walked
packages.done: Walked again and signed off.

stages.name: Life
stages.goal: It is a place to play: resources, creatures, people and hooks, counted against the brief.

packages.name: Resources
packages.done: Trees, rocks, fishing and other gathering placed by count and tier as the brief and docs/skills.md say.

packages.name: Creatures
packages.done: Creatures by count and level, their spawns reachable and readable; danger reads before it bites.

packages.name: People and services
packages.done: Townsfolk, banks, shops and transport as the area plan's infrastructure pass puts them.

packages.name: Hooks
packages.done: Quest hooks, readables and secrets placed.

packages.name: Checked
packages.done: No traps, every place reachable, every challenge's supplies obtainable (docs/areas/rules.md); ShippedMapTests pass.

packages.name: Played
packages.done: Played through by the owner and signed off.

packages.name: Assets
packages.done: Every blockout stand-in replaced by its asset (the area's asset list is empty).

packages.name: Dressing
packages.done: Set dressing and the scenery you see but can't reach.

packages.name: Atmosphere
packages.done: Light, fog, music and sound.

packages.name: Final walk
packages.done: Measured for performance on a streamed walk, screenshots in docs, signed off.
